correctness.rationale: The fixed n,T,kappa cosine law, radial density and beta angle law give a complete local expansion at all antipodal boundary maximizers. The dimension-three exact formula follows by a justified change of variables. The standalone checker passed 36 numerical assertions; these support, but do not replace, the analytic argument.
